title: Two-Week Battery and the PowerPack
lessons: The player is heading into a long beach day and notices that current WHOOP hardware advertises more than two weeks of battery life.
The player already wears WHOOP and uses the PowerPack to charge it without taking it off during a beach day.

text: The player is heading into a long beach day and notices that current WHOOP hardware advertises more than two weeks of battery life.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I left every charger at home on purpose.

entry-first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Good. You do not need one for me today.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: That is the first relaxing thing you have ever said.

entry-first-4.speaker: WHOOP
text: Current hardware is rated for 14-plus days. Today, battery life gets to be the whole pitch.

choice-first.speaker: WHOOP
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: That actually matters to me on days like this.
Battery claims depend on how the thing is used.
I do not want another wearable charger in my bag at all.

first-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Finally, a metric you find emotionally soothing.

first-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Battery life is the healthiest thing about us.

first-1-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: I will log that as progress.

first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Correct. Rated battery life is still rated battery life, not a personal guarantee.

first-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then the longest battery is still one charger too many.
The player already wears WHOOP and uses the PowerPack to charge it without taking it off during a beach day.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Do I have to take you off to charge you?

entry-return-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: No. The PowerPack charges me while you wear me.

choice-return.speaker: WHOOP
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: That is exactly the kind of tiny convenience I notice.
I am still carrying a proprietary charger.
If a tracker cannot survive being removed for charging, I do not need continuous data.

return-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Tiny friction is where habits usually die. I take the win.

return-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Yes. Convenient proprietary hardware is still proprietary hardware.

return-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then missing a few hours may matter less to you than maintaining the streak matters to me.
